propositions: Gerrit Verified-gate workflows (gerrit-verify.yaml and five reusables) were never audited by zizmor for pinning/credential-persistence/template-injection issues
SHA-pin assertion in gerrit-verify.yaml line 21 was partly false; mutable actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-python@v7 existed in reusable workflows called by the vote path
Packaging metadata regression could pass Verified +1 gate because twine check ran only at release time, not pre-merge
Template-injection finding in _mutation.yml matrix.shard and credential-persistence findings in non-pushing checkouts require zizmor remediation
All mutable action refs (checkout@v7, setup-python@v7) across vote-path workflows must be SHA-pinned with version comments to make the Verified gate claim true
twine check --strict must run pre-merge in _artifact-probe.yml after artifact build to validate package metadata before Verified vote
